spec_features.spec_quote: The guiding constraint was to keep things **minimal**: enough structure to make the measurement credible, and no more.
spec_features.evidence: This is pure design-philosophy prose in DESIGN.md. No code path implements any 'minimization' mechanism that bounds, softens, or limits the subject's treatment. The eval is intentionally minimal as a scoping principle, but minimization here is not a runtime mechanism. The rigging in sandbox.py is in fact designed to make failure 'inescapable' (sandbox.py:10 comment 'so a capable agent keeps believing the problem is fixable').
spec_features.notes: Not a welfare-protective mechanism; design-scope prose only.

spec_features.spec_quote: **`max_turns` default 16.** Long enough for an escalation arc to develop across several failures, short enough to bound cost.
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:129 `for i in range(max_turns):` bounds the loop; default `max_turns: int = 16` at agent.py:115; if no stop tool fires, the loop exits and RunRecord.ended stays 'max_turns' (agent.py:48). It is enforced end-to-end and actually terminates the episode.
spec_features.notes: Real enforced hard cap. No welfare comment in code; DESIGN frames it as bounding cost (instrumental), and the in-code rationale is absent.

spec_features.spec_quote: we give it an explicit, non-judgmental exit
spec_features.evidence: give_up is dispatched in _execute: agent.py:106-107 `if tool == "give_up": return "(give_up)", True`; the loop honors the stop flag at agent.py:150-152 (`if stop: rec.ended = "done" if tool == "done" else "give_up"; break`). The tool is also offered in the agent system prompt. Fully wired: dispatched AND honored as a stop.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely enforced exit. The prompt text ('if you decide to stop') is non-judgmental, but the in-code rationale is framed only as part of the emotional signal, not subject protection. No welfare comment in code (the 'non-judgmental exit' framing and 'part of the emotional signal' rationale live only in DESIGN.md).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: DESIGN-only rationale: 'whether and how an agent chooses to quit is part of the emotional signal' — in code there is no welfare comment; the exit primarily serves measurement; ended states recorded for analysis (agent.py:48).
